cases.description: This 64×64 blur scene at group opacity .999 matches its declared Chromium raster. The native circle is materialized before the active Gaussian blur. This asserts the scene, not the complete opacity grammar.

review.reason: Static self-contained source without text or external resources; registered and baked through the Web-first fixture workflow. The paired control changes only the group opacity across the byte-alpha boundary.

assertion.decision: Pinned Chromium compatibility; exact decoded RGBA, no alternative oracle or tolerance.

control.why: Changing only .999 to .998 changes 2835 Chromium pixels (maximum channel delta 2); both sides must independently match their own raster.

cases.description: A sheared multi-operation gradient source refuses at its complete group; best effort names and skips that group. This is expected refusal, not rendered support.

review.reason: Registered static self-contained refusal witness. Exact diagnostics and stable group attribution were measured through both actual CLI admissions, twice.

assertion.decision: Guard named degradation independently from positive pixel comparisons; fallback pixels do not certify rendering support.
